class.name: SteamPurchaseCart
class.brief_description: Branchable purchase selection containing game SKUs and quantities.
class.description: Build a cart with [method with_item]. Crimson assigns its stable checkout ID on first submission. Save it with the original cart to recover a lost response. A different item or quantity creates a different checkout.

method.name: with_item
method.description: Returns an independent branch with the quantity for this SKU replaced. A SKU uses 1 to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes, or underscores. A cart holds up to 32 SKUs. Quantities range from 1 through 1000. Invalid selections return null.

method.name: with_checkout_id
method.description: Returns the same selection with a previously assigned 32-character lowercase hexadecimal retry ID. Returns null if the ID is invalid.

method.name: lines
method.description: Returns a read-only copy of the typed SKU selections.

members.member: Stable checkout retry ID. Empty until first checkout assigns it. Read on the main thread.
